segments.text: La Elaha Ella Allah (There is no god but One God)

We praise God and we bear witness there is only One God.
God is doing everything.
And this is the conclusion that we must reach
if we are to be saved.
That God is doing everything is a quality of God.
If you don't know this quality, then you don't know God.
And this is why the Quran is full of those verses
talking about people who do believe in God
but they're going to Hell
because they do not know God as He really is.
In Sura 8, verse 17,
we're told that God...
There was the appearance of a battle
with a small handful of believers fighting a big huge army of disbelievers.
And the believers were busy running around and stabbing and throwing arrows and shooting, thinking they are fighting,
but the verse tells us that God is the One who's fighting; God is the One who did the killing and the throwing of the arrows.
God is doing everything.
We only do the decision to be with God or not.
And the whole design of this life is to effect a test for each one of us.
This whole life is a test,
nothing else.
And we read in Sura 51, verse 56 that God created this whole universe,
created us just to worship Him alone.
Anything else are just the means for provision,
the jobs, what you do to go to school to find work, develop your talents or whatever.
It's just an outside appearance to provide for you,
give you the dollars, the food, the roof over your head and so on.
But the main job, when you wake up in the morning, my main job today is to worship God Alone.
And to observe my duties towards God.
All those duties, of course, are designed for our own benefit to develop and grow our soul
through the prayers, the fasting and so on.
But the whole world is designed for a test
in that a person is required to pray before sunrise, for example

And some person may say "oh, the sun is rising too early
4 o'clock in the morning, you know, in July and August."
They complain.

segments.text: Alhamdu Lillah, praise be to God
Wa Ash-hadu Alla Elaha Ella Allah Wahdahu La Shareeka Lah.
And I bear witness there's no god except the One God.
Our topic today is a very important one, marriage in Islam. God has prescribed for us laws
to govern the important aspects of our lives and He left a lot of freedom for many other aspects in our lives.
And we're told that these laws are recommendations or Commandments. They are Commandments because we should do them.
And they are recommendations because we have the freedom not to do them
as long as we are ready to pay the price. God tells us in SURAH 10 verse 62
that if you follow these Commandments, you are guaranteed happiness, perfect happiness in this world
and tells us in SURAH 21 verse 142 that if you disregard these Commandments, you are guaranteed a miserable life.
So, it is very important for us to know  these laws with regard to every aspect of
our lives and today I'm going to share with  you the commandments dealing with marriage
There are two requirements that must be fulfilled.
for two people to get married and these are number one is love and we see this in SURAH 4 verse 24.
The Arabic is " فَمَا ٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهِۦ مِنْهُنَّ "
the ones that you like, you get married to. So, love must exist between the two and this cannot happen without
good acquaintance with the person. You must know the person. You must know his or her habits
and you must know his or her temper. You must know his or her principles. You just... you must know
the person. You cannot love a person without knowing that person. So, this calls for a period
of acquaintance, getting to know each other and then based on that knowledge, you either
love the person or not and God tells you  if you love the person then you get married.
God says that if this is the  person intended for you, God will
put love in your hearts and this  is SURAH 30 verse 21.
So, the first requirement before ever becoming intimate is love. You must know each other
very well and you must be in love with  each other and God will help you along
if this is the right person. You don't love the  person, that is not the right person for you.
The second requirement is dowry for the wife and we understand throughout the Quran
we understand from the Quran that the purpose of the dowry is security for the woman because in
many cases, you are taking a girl from her parents' house. Then, she becomes dependent on the husband.
This is the majority of wives in the whole world and you can't just throw her out after a year or two
because she's not the same person and after what the Quran calls a formidable oath
has been made between the two of you. So,  the purpose of the dowry is security.
And this can be obtained by writing a contract and pay the dowry in advance or saying that if
divorce takes place or if the marriage breaks up, then the wife must be given a certain amount
of money that will provide her security. The Quran is very careful in this respect even where divorce...
In SURAH 2 verse 240 and 241,  we see that divorcees must be given
alimony or some kind of security. In SURAH 65, the first verse says, very carefully, that you can't
kick the wife out of your house and this provides security for the wife. This is the divorced wife.
And you cannot even fabricate conditions and  situations to make them so miserable that
they leave on their own. You must guarantee their house... their housing and staying with their children
and she will not be the man's wife. He cannot  touch her, but she has to stay in that house.
She must be provided with security of housing, provisions and this is throughout the Quran. So, this is the
purpose of the dowry. These are the two conditions. There must be a sufficient period of time for the
two people to know each other and to satisfy the first requirement of love before becoming intimate.
What is being done now, what my parents  did and what is happening in most Muslim
countries is they actually do the official marriage.
And then the now-husband and wife, they don't touch  each other. They do not become intimate but this
marriage, official marriage gives them a chance to be together alone, hold hands, go places, know each
other and then after months or a year or years, the marriage is consummated. And of course during

I'm just kidding.

self-discipline and self-control. I mean, Ramadan is coming up where you're gonna tell you body
"you're not gonna eat or drink until sunset." This is self....it takes self-discipline and self-control.

the human being becomes worse than animals and this is... there's a specific reference in the
Quran for this in SURAH 7 verse 179. God calls some people "they are like animals even worse."
I mean, what is happening now in  this country and in Europe is that
people meet. They don't even know each other. "Let's hop in bed." This is worse than animals.

cause
